items.title: Return completed damage questionnaire and wildlife-damage certificate
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: Letter is dated 21.11.2026 (Saturday). Period runs 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens' (after the date of this letter), so per §187 BGB the letter date itself is excluded and counting of the 13 Werktage starts the next calendar day, 22.11.2026 (Sunday). 'Werktage' is explicitly defined by the sender as Monday–Saturday excluding statutory public holidays, so Sundays and holidays are skipped entirely (not just for the final day). Counting Werktage from 22.11.2026: Su22.11 skip; Werktag1=Mo23.11; 2=Tu24.11; 3=We25.11; 4=Th26.11; 5=Fr27.11; 6=Sa28.11; Su29.11 skip; 7=Mo30.11; 8=Tu01.12; 9=We02.12; 10=Th03.12; 11=Fr04.12; 12=Sa05.12; Su06.12 skip; 13=Mo07.12.2026. No NRW public holidays fall in this window (next NRW holiday after 01.11 Allerheiligen is 25.12 Weihnachten), so no adjustment needed. Final day of the 13-Werktage period is 07.12.2026.
